---
title: "Comparison of Bacterial Classification between Captured and Non-captured Sequencing"
output:
  pdf_document: default
  html_notebook: default
---

```{r}
# Load necessary libraries
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(rprojroot)
library(eoffice) # Load eoffice library for PPTX output

# Read the file paths of the data
cap_file <- sprintf("%s/data/metaphlan_cap_merged_abundance_table.txt", find_rstudio_root_file())
nocap_file <- sprintf("%s/data/metaphlan_nocap_merged_abundance_table.txt", find_rstudio_root_file())

# Read data, skip the first line
cap_data <- read.table(cap_file, header = TRUE, skip = 1)
nocap_data <- read.table(nocap_file, header = TRUE, skip = 1)

# List of samples
samples <- c("WS_0717_DXL", "WS_0717_HCZ", "WS_0717_RHN", "WS_0717_SLZ", "WS_0717_SY", "WS_0717_ZHGC",
             "WS_0724_DXL", "WS_0724_HCZ", "WS_0724_RHN", "WS_0724_SLZ", "WS_0724_SY", "WS_0724_ZHGC",
             "WS_0731_RHN", "WS_0731_SY", "WS_0731_ZHGC", "WS_0807_RHN", "WS_0807_SY", "WS_0807_ZHGC",
             "WS_0814_RHN", "WS_0814_SY", "WS_0814_ZHGC")

# Function to select samples and fill missing with zeros
select_and_fill <- function(data) {
  available_samples <- colnames(data)[-1]
  missing_samples <- setdiff(samples, available_samples)
  new_data <- data %>%
    select(clade_name, all_of(intersect(samples, available_samples)))
  for (sample in missing_samples) {
    new_data[[sample]] <- 0
  }
  new_data <- new_data %>%
    select(clade_name, all_of(samples))
  return(new_data)
}

# Select samples from cap and nocap data
cap_selected <- select_and_fill(cap_data)
nocap_selected <- select_and_fill(nocap_data)

# Function to extract level data
extract_level <- function(data, level) {
  level_patterns <- list(
    "kingdom" = "k__[^|]+",
    "phylum" = "p__[^|]+",
    "class" = "c__[^|]+",
    "order" = "o__[^|]+",
    "family" = "f__[^|]+",
    "genus" = "g__[^|]+",
    "species" = "s__[^|]+")
  
  pattern <- level_patterns[[level]]
  if (is.null(pattern)) {
    stop("Invalid level specified.")
  }
  
  data %>%
    filter(str_detect(clade_name, pattern) & str_count(clade_name, "\\|") == which(names(level_patterns) == level) - 1) %>%
    mutate(level_name = str_extract(clade_name, pattern)) %>%
    select(-clade_name) %>%
    group_by(level_name) %>%
    summarise_all(sum) %>%
    pivot_longer(-level_name, names_to = "sample", values_to = "abundance")
}

# Extract data for each level from cap and nocap data
levels <- c("kingdom", "phylum", "class", "order", "family", "genus", "species")
cap_level_data <- map(levels, ~extract_level(cap_selected,.x))
nocap_level_data <- map(levels, ~extract_level(nocap_selected,.x))

# Add a column to indicate capture status and combine data for each level
combined_level_data <- map2(cap_level_data, nocap_level_data, function(cap, nocap) {
  cap$capture_status <- "HybCapSeq"
  nocap$capture_status <- "MetaT"
  bind_rows(cap, nocap)
})

# Function to replace CFGB, OFGB, FGB, GGB, SGB and s__GGB32253_SGB56808
replace_bins <- function(data, level) {
  if (level == "class") {
    data$level_name <- ifelse(str_detect(data$level_name, "c__CFGB"), "class-level genome bins", data$level_name)
  } else if (level == "order") {
    data$level_name <- ifelse(str_detect(data$level_name, "o__OFGB"), "order-level genome bins", data$level_name)
  } else if (level == "family") {
    data$level_name <- ifelse(str_detect(data$level_name, "f__FGB"), "family-level genome bins", data$level_name)
  } else if (level == "genus") {
    data$level_name <- ifelse(str_detect(data$level_name, "g__GGB"), "genus-level genome bins", data$level_name)
  } else if (level == "species") {
    data$level_name <- ifelse(str_detect(data$level_name, "s__GGB32253_SGB56808|s__SGB"), "species-level genome bins", data$level_name)
  }
  return(data)
}

# Apply replacement function to each level's data
combined_level_data <- map2(combined_level_data, levels, replace_bins)

# Thresholds for grouping low-abundance taxa
thresholds <- c(0.1, 0.2, 0.5, 2, 2, 2)
names(thresholds) <- levels[-1]

# Function to group low-abundance taxa
group_low_abundance <- function(data, level) {
  if (level == "kingdom") {
    return(data)
  }
  threshold <- thresholds[[level]]
  other_name <- paste0("Other ", level, "s")
  grouped <- data %>%
    group_by(sample, capture_status) %>%
    mutate(total_abundance = sum(abundance)) %>%
    mutate(relative_abundance = abundance / total_abundance * 100) %>%
    mutate(level_name = ifelse(relative_abundance < threshold, other_name, level_name)) %>%
    group_by(sample, capture_status, level_name) %>%
    summarise(abundance = sum(abundance),.groups = "drop")
  return(grouped)
}

# Apply grouping function to each level's data
combined_level_data <- map2(combined_level_data, levels, group_low_abundance)

# Remove NA values from level_name
combined_level_data <- map(combined_level_data, ~ filter(.x,!is.na(level_name)))

# Remove k__Archaea from kingdom level if not present
combined_level_data[[1]] <- combined_level_data[[1]] %>%
  filter(level_name != "k__Archaea" | level_name %in% unique(.$level_name[.$abundance > 0]))

# New color palette
cns_colors <- c("#bdbdbd","#4DBBD5", "#00A087", "#3C5488", "#F39B7F", "#8491B4", "#91D1C2",  "#7E6148", "#B09C85", "#4a1486", "#e8743c","#6a51a3", "#8264CC", "#3C5488B2", "#0072B2", "#4387B5", "#5D90BA", "#56B4E9", "#4DBBD5B2", "#2EBEBE", "#009E73", "#167153", "#4c9568", "#356d67", "#74B346", "#7CC767", "#b0d45d","#E64B35", "#7fb961", "#8EA325", "#A9D179", "#91D1C2B2", "#84CAC0", "#F1CC2F", "#D8D155", "#ffe788", "#ffc556", "#F5AE6B", "#eb998b", "#cca69c", "#BCB8D3", "#8491B4B2", "#9e9ac8", "#737373", "#999999",  "#9ecae1", "#76afda", "#abddff", "#dcf2ff", "#fddbc8","#252525", "#562e3c", "#7A142C",  "#E64B35B2",  "#223D6C", "#004529", "#42465c", "#7d4444", "#9e6c69", "#8c510a", "#A14462", "#a14462",  "#bf812d", "#D55E00",  "#E0367A", "#df65b0", "#CC79A7")

# Function to create sample ID mapping (S1, S2, ..., S21)
create_sample_mapping <- function(samples) {
  sample_mapping <- setNames(paste0("S", 1:length(samples)), samples)
  return(sample_mapping)
}

# Create sample mapping
sample_mapping <- create_sample_mapping(samples)

# Function to plot stacked bar chart for a given level with new sample IDs
plot_level_chart <- function(data, level) {
  num_levels <- length(unique(data$level_name))
  if (num_levels <= length(cns_colors)) {
    colors <- cns_colors[1:num_levels]
  } else {
    warning("More levels than available colors. Some levels may have duplicate colors.")
    colors <- rep(cns_colors, length.out = num_levels)
  }
  
  # Map original sample names to new IDs (S1, S2, ..., S21)
  data$sample_id <- sample_mapping[data$sample]
  
  ggplot(data, aes(x = factor(sample_id, levels = paste0("S", 1:length(samples))), y = abundance, fill = level_name)) +
    geom_col() +
    labs(x = "Sample", y = "Relative Abundance (%)", title = paste("Bacterial", level, "Abundance Comparison")) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = colors) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
    theme(
      axis.text = element_text(size = 12), 
      axis.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1),
      strip.text = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold")
    )  +
    facet_wrap(~ capture_status, nrow = 2)
}

# Plot and save charts for each level as PDF and PPTX
map2(combined_level_data, levels, function(data, level) {
  chart <- plot_level_chart(data, level)
  
  # Save as PDF
  pdf_output_path <- sprintf("%s/charts/Bacterial_%s_Abundance_Comparison.pdf", find_rstudio_root_file(), level)
  ggsave(pdf_output_path, chart, width = 16, height = 8)
  
  # Save as PPTX
  pptx_output_path <- sprintf("%s/charts/Bacterial_%s_Abundance_Comparison.pptx", find_rstudio_root_file(), level)
  topptx(chart, filename = pptx_output_path, height = 8, width = 16)
})
```
